lines: It was Mitsuki who attacked first.
It was a Whirlwind Cut Art, which stirred air around at ultra-high speed, and minced enemies to pieces with the vacuum blades that were produced.
The space which encompassed the enemies became bright red.
Countless vacuum blades cut apart the tough skin of the orcs and troll, and the blood that gushed out swirled around in a brightly-coloured vortex.
「Guuh...... Shit! Ya think we'll be done in by these puny scratches?!!」
While shedding blood from all over his body, the troll, who appeared to be the leader of the guards, howled in anger.
Indeed, with their thick skin and stamina, Mitsuki could not inflict fatal wounds to these guys with whirlwind cuts alone.
「This one's a cinch. Ninja Art: Poison Death Blossom!!」
Without even giving the enemies time to counterattack, Mutsuho breathed out a toxic mist.
A strong, deadly poison permeated their bodies directly through the wounds that had been made all over them.
The orcs made terrible screams, and collapsed.
They just writhed a few times on the floor, and ceased moving in the blink of an eye.
This was the sadistic side of Mutsuho, which was so extreme that it scared even Mitsuki a little.
「Sh-Shiiid...... You azzholes...... Aww'll gill you...... uguguh......」
Despite having his entire body afflicted by poison, the troll, which had greater endurance than the orcs, mustered the last of his strength to try and approach them.
「You are the one who's going to die.」
Rin swiftly moved towards the troll, and stabbed him with one of her blades, which she had enveloped in lightning bolts.
It was a merciless finishing blow.
Making an unpleasant electric crackle, the troll collapsed to the floor with a thud.
The mouth of the cut in his chest was completely charred, and he no longer even twitched.
The enemies had been wiped out.
Mitsuki breathed a sigh of relief.
The surprise attack had succeeded in an ideal manner.
They had been able to defeat the guards without taking any damage at all.
Despite the fact that she had issued tactical instructions as the commander, she had understandably been a little worried about whether it would go well.
「Thanks, Prez. Felt nice to kill them.」
Mutsuho said words of thanks in her characteristic way.
Mitsuki raised a hand towards Mutsuho.
After blinking her eyes, dumbfounded, Mutsuho nodded, and slapped Mitsuki's hand.
And then, she looked at her own hand like she was a little confused.
「We've never done something like this before, have we?」
Though she hesitated briefly, Mitsuki promptly held her hand up for Rin as well.
Rin knit her brows slightly, looking as though she weren't expecting that, but
「You gotta do it over here too, “Uehara-san.”」
Mutsuho smirked, while also raising her own hand, and
Despite making a wry smile, she reciprocated the two high fives.
「It's bound to soon come to the attention of the Lady of the Spiders that these guys have been defeated. Let's hurry.」
Rin forced the pair of them to keep their wits about them, very much like she was making an excuse.
Mitsuki and Mutsuho exchanged looks and giggled.
The party opened the door that the guards had been protecting, and pressed onward.
All of a sudden, their setting changed to an ordinary room.
The atmosphere was clearly different from before.
It was that of a rather luxurious mansion, and the dining room at that.
A nice carpet on the floor.
A long table and chairs in the middle of the room.
A pure-white cloth was draped neatly over it, and lined with tableware.
A great many (obviously expensive-looking) paintings were decorating the walls of the room.
It was like a dining room for aristocrats or something to entertain their guests at parties.
It appeared that what the guards from before had been defending was the door to a hidden passage leading here.
「Superbly classy, eh? I can see the taste of that “Lady of the Spiders”, or whatever.」
There was no sign of people.
However, as soon as they had entered this dining room, the shaking from aboveground had suddenly stopped.
They couldn't hear the sounds of it, either.
It was clearly unnatural, when the diversionary operation should still be going on.
All her hairs stood on end.
「Don't let your guards down, either of you. She's here.」
That instant, the lights of the room came on.
「You have done well to reach my mansion. I bid you welcome, flies.」
